1. $h_t=\tanh(W_{xh}x_t+W_{hh}h_{t-1}+b)$ (activation may vary).
2. The same transition should apply at every step; sharing cuts parameters and ties the dynamics.
3. Backprop through many time steps multiplies Jacobians, so gradients can shrink toward zero.
4. The previous cell state $c_{t-1}$ (elementwise).
5. GRU has no separate cell and typically two gates; LSTM has cell + three gates.
